prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray (sunless) tanning or UV (tanning beds)? And any preferred neighborhood in Charlotte (Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, etc.)?

If you want a quick pointer while you answer: here’s how to pick the “best” salon for you
- Decide spray vs. UV — spray/sunless is much safer for your skin (no UV exposure). If you want a longer-lasting bronzed look, ask about multi-step airbrush or custom solutions.  
- Check recent Google and Yelp reviews and Instagram before/after photos. Look for consistent comments about natural color, even application, and friendly techs.  
- Ask whether technicians are certified (e.g., in Mystic or Versa airbrush systems) and whether they offer patch tests and color customization.  
- Inspect cleanliness and smell when you arrive; a good salon will use fresh solution, disposable hair/eye covers, and have visible sanitation.  
- Compare pricing and package deals, and read the cancellation and refund policy.  
- Safety: if you plan UV tanning, check bed maintenance, timer calibration, and that staff ask about skin type/meds. Consider sunless alternatives to reduce skin cancer risk.

If you tell me spray vs. UV and what part of Charlotte you’re near, I’ll suggest a short list of well-reviewed salons to try.
